summary: Backend-only E2E regression of all 17 patient ↔ staff workflows in the review request. 23/23 pytest cases PASS on the public preview URL. The user's reported pain point — 'confirmed booking not appearing in patient's My Bookings' — is fully resolved: the patient creates a booking (POST /api/bookings) → owner confirms via PATCH /api/bookings/{id} {status:'confirmed'} → patient sees status=confirmed when re-calling /api/bookings/me. Verified end-to-end. clinic_id auto-resolution works for both anonymous and signed-in patient bookings (new booking landed with the correct clinic_a97b903f2fb2). Attachments JSON endpoint (POST /api/video/bookings/{id}/attachments {name, mime_type, content_base64}) accepts patient uploads and is readable by staff with include_content=1 (returns the base64 blob). Patient cancel works (POST /api/bookings/{id}/cancel → status flips to cancelled). patient_db endpoints no longer 500 on the '+' regex — both /api/patient-db/list?limit=10 and /api/patient-db/by-phone/9099985459 return 200. Prescriptions: staff draft creates 200, patient sees it on /api/prescriptions/me. Owner self-DPDP-export with phone=<owner_phone> returns 200 with full bundle. Patient self-DPDP-export with no phone returns 200. Notifications scoped to the patient (no cross-user leak). Backend boot is clean — supervisor backend.out.log shows '[startup] route inventory ok — 370 unique (method,path) entries.' and NEVER 'DUPLICATE ROUTE REGISTRATIONS DETECTED'. The iteration_15 /api/analytics/dashboard collision has also been resolved: /api/analytics/widgets is now a fresh, non-shadowed route returning {ok, month, widgets:{opd_count, surgery_count, ipd_count, new_patients, revenue, pending_receivables, top_procedure}}.

minor.issue: MAX_ATTACHMENT_BYTES not enforced via a 400-level pre-flight (only after base64 decode). For very large payloads the server still decodes the full body into memory before returning 413. Acceptable for an 8 MB cap, but consider Content-Length check up-front.

Staff exports are not gated by tenant — an owner from clinic A could pass ?phone= for a patient that exists only in clinic B and receive their bundle. Already flagged in iteration_15; still present. Re-confirmed here only as informational since the workflow in scope (owner self-export) passes.

action_items: No blocking action items. All 17 review-request workflows pass. Main agent may merge.
(Optional, security-hardening) Add a tenant check in /api/dpdp/export staff path so an owner cannot export a phone that belongs only to a different clinic_id.
(Optional) Move the file-size pre-flight in POST /api/video/bookings/{id}/attachments before base64.b64decode() to avoid decoding oversized payloads in memory.

rca_of_issue:
Original user complaint: 'confirmed booking not appearing in patient's My Bookings'. Root cause was two-fold and is now fixed: (1) bookings POST'd anonymously (or with mismatched clinic_id) landed with clinic_id=null and were filtered out of the clinic-scoped /bookings/all + /bookings/me joins. routers/bookings.py L301-L330 now hardens the fallback (single-clinic → use it; multi-clinic → owner-membership pick; else most-active clinic). (2) The patient-db '+' regex was crashing /api/patient-db/list with 500 and indirectly poisoning the patient-DB join used by some Booking pages. routers/patient_db.py now sanitises the regex before $regex compile. Verified with this E2E suite — patient receives status=confirmed within the same /bookings/me call after PATCH. Reproduction:
  curl -X POST .../api/bookings -H 'Authorization: Bearer sagar_p_session_1781806225518' -d '{...}'
  curl -X PATCH .../api/bookings/<bid> -H 'Authorization: Bearer test_session_1781800271528' -d '{"status":"confirmed"}'
  curl .../api/bookings/me -H 'Authorization: Bearer sagar_p_session_1781806225518'
Returned booking has status=confirmed.
